Real Mongo aborted-source connections recover after the stall

Real Mongo pool pressure queues and drains without lost queries
Real history query uses bounded index access
Real unique query uses bounded index access

environment.redisConfig:
bind 127.0.0.1
port <ephemeral>
protected-mode yes
save ""
appendonly no
maxmemory 64mb
maxmemory-policy noeviction
environment.normalTrafficRedisPath: direct loopback WSL Redis; proxy used only for explicit Redis fault tests

capacityTransport: Mongo fault proxy; direct shared Redis; no CPU profiler

workerRestart.routing: verifier routes away from draining worker; real load balancer remains deployment gate
